results.title: What You Once Were
results.overview: A boy spends a weekend with his grandpa, who has promised to teach him how to develop photographs. They have never spent this much time together before. The boy soon discovers that his grandpa is a very serious and quiet man. What initially seems like a boring activity sparks a passion that unites them both in an unexpected way.

results.title: Falling White Leaves
results.overview: Thomas and Félix, a father and son long estranged, reunite for a picturesque photographic journey through the south of Puerto Rico, embarking on an adventure that leads them to an unexpected new descendant of their family.

results.title: Breathwork
results.overview: During a breathwork session, a reluctant skeptic opens herself to "new energies" and lets in something far darker.

results.title: The Valley where LOAB Lives
results.overview: LOAB is a creature of generative AI. The product of an anti-prompt, it haunts – as both a glitch and a ghost – the worlds of human-machine-made horror. In The Valley Where LOAB Lives, Georg Tiller takes his film craft by the horns and creates a whole new brand of storytelling: the Promptus. The Promptus openly reveals its origins and the problems inherent within it: “Working with generative models means working within systems that are designed to obscure their own origins.” In this film, he has found an ingenious solution to this problem, linking LOAB’s generated probabilities with the monstrous improbabilities of the film genre. Observing with a winking eye.

results.title: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 5
results.overview: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 5 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on March 21, 2026 at 176BOX in Osaka, Japan.

results.title: Water Diary
results.overview: In June of 2025, I took my 16mm camera to the shore of Lake Michigan every day in an attempt to capture a handful of its many moods.

results.title: Leite em Pó
results.overview: A musician of limited talent and obsessed with rock music sees his life collapse after a devastating family loss. Alone and penniless, he takes on a new job that forces him to wander the city, where he crosses paths with a wide variety of people who challenge his worldview. Between unsettling memories and these new urban bonds, he begins an erratic and transformative journey to confront his own ghosts and try to reconnect with reality.

results.title: Blood of a Mole
results.overview: Angelina’s white lie, intended to help, turns into her own sacrifice.

results.title: Baby Wants Candy: DCM '26
results.overview: World renowned musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy (“Truly Amazing! Critics Pick!” New York Times) makes up a musical based on your title. Some recent titles we’ve liked: “Project Hail Mary Poppins”, “Sweeney Toddler” and the seminal “Hotuncles.com…the Musical”.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

results.title: Made To Walk
results.overview: In 40,000 years of existence, the human being – Homo sapiens – has never walked so little. With the decline of walking, are we at risk of losing our humanity? Made To Walk explores this question through intimate encounters with a gallery of extra/ordinary individuals — walkers and scientists — who reclaim or redefine walking as a way to reconnect with themselves. In a world that is increasingly sedentary, virtual, and fragmented, they each, in their own way, resist gravity, imbalance, the loss of identity, direction, or the experience of grief, by responding to the vital and inevitable call to stand and move on two feet.

results.title: Prudence and the Wandering Eye
results.overview: In a strange, purgatory-like room where workers exchange small bundles for coins, Prudence notices an elderly blind woman waiting in line. She offers to help, but her seemingly good deed soon takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: Dog without Feathers
results.overview: From the Agreste to the sea, the Capibaribe River inspires the poetry of João Cabral de Melo Neto and the dance of Deborah Colker. This documentary is a road movie in which performance, the body, and poetry fuel a journey that begins at the river’s source and flows out to the open sea, moving between the arid landscape and the ocean, between devastation and what endures.

results.title: L'inconnue
results.overview: The story plunges us into a hangar at night, where friends are having fun with a disguise, unintentionally frightening their friend who is standing guard.

results.title: Deja Vu
results.overview: After discovering being trapped in a time loop, Carl has three more chances to make things right to break the loop or be blinked out of existence forever.

results.title: To Make It Back Home
results.overview: To Make It Back Home is the story of a man who has lost his place to stand in life, embarking on a long journey through his own inner emptiness and the unseen wounds of the country. As Anıl drifts between cities, people, and events, he is forced to confront loss, guilt, and a deep sense of not belonging. Everywhere he believes he has escaped to, he encounters the same void. Home ceases to be an address and becomes a reckoning with the past, family, and himself.

results.title: The Hero
results.overview: At the end of the Great War, a soldier burdened with informing a mother of her son's death, faces an impossible decision... Tell her a noble lie, or the horrible truth?

results.title: Closed for Maintenance
results.overview: In a suspenseful, thrilling, and psychologically mysterious setting, a man and a woman find themselves trapped inside a malfunctioning elevator in an enclosed location. The power goes out, and the surveillance cameras stop working, slowing down the rescue efforts and intensifying the tension and psychological conflict between the two trapped characters as they try to escape.

results.title: Spot Fuera de Campo
results.overview: How much does light weigh? asks Clarice Lispector.  It weighs as much as a camera. It weighs as much as the person who turns it on. The weight of their heart. Of their old romances. It also weighs a little more because there are their memories, some unforgettable. But what's the point of calculating. What's the point of naming. Kilos. Words. That makes the light disappear. I was wrong, Clarice, light is not weighed, it is filmed. And whoever films it has to carry the weight that comes with seeing the light, the weight of wanting to see it again. I met a man who, when he turned on the camera, the light appeared. And he liked filming it so much that he went very close to the sun. But he told me that's not the light. That light appears when we wait seated in the dark. Like in a movie theater? I asked him. And then he didn't want to answer me anymore.

results.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu
results.original_title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu
results.overview: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.
